newsitem.title: USA: Tele-Comms Intl offers Japan phone service.
newsitem.headline: Tele-Comms Intl offers Japan phone service.

text.p: Tele-Communications International Inc said that its Jupiter Telecommunications unit debuted telephone service through its J-COM Suginami cable system on July 1, 1997.

The digital telephony service, known as "CablePhone," is the natural progression of J-COM Suginami's telephony trials and complements the J-COM Suginami cable TV service, Tele-Communications International said in a statement on Wednesday.

The system's hybrid fiber-coaxial network with ultra-high capacity is able to provide telephony with little additional investment, said the company, which is a publicly traded subsidiary of U.S. cable giant Tele-Communications Inc.
